description: WebSocket remote functions for SvelteKit 3: stream() and mutate() in *.socket.ts files, served over one multiplexed WebSocket in vite dev and by Bun or Node adapters, with a pub/sub bus and an in-memory test client.
rules: Set up with `npx sv add svelte-ws`, or install svelte-ws and put `svelte-ws/adapter-node` or `svelte-ws/adapter-bun` in the `sveltekit()` call in vite.config.ts; no hooks.server.ts changes are needed.
Export `stream()` and `mutate()` from `*.socket.ts` files and import them in components the way remote functions are imported.
svelte-ws needs SvelteKit 3 and a long-running Bun or Node server; it does not run on serverless platforms.
With adapter-bun, build with `bun --bun vite build`; `vite dev` works under either runtime.
If updates only flow from the server to the browser, SvelteKit's `query.live` may be enough.
Test socket modules with `createTestClient` from `svelte-ws/testing` instead of starting a server.
